Welcome to LessonSpace

Bobbin opens your lessons in LessonSpace, an online whiteboard with video. Here is what to expect the first time.

Allow your camera and microphone

Your browser asks the first time the room opens. Choose Allow so your students can see and hear you.

Send each student their own link

Once a lesson starts, press Invite in the lesson tools beside the room to copy their links, or find them on the lesson page. Each link is for one person, so attendance and insights stay accurate.

Your files are already in the room

Open the library panel inside the room for your shared files, the resources attached to this course, and your own uploads.

Everything comes back to Bobbin

When the lesson ends, the transcript, chat and recording (if lessons are recorded) appear on the lesson in Bobbin.
